concerns.text: T008 mandates a top-level `robustness_warning` key in results.json AND mandates validation against contracts/analysis_result.schema.yaml, but that schema declares `additionalProperties: false` and does not list `robustness_warning` (or `sensitivity_analysis`/`concept_id` in `required`). The task's own verification step will deterministically fail no matter how the implementer executes it. Fix the task (or the contract) so the required keys and the schema agree before execution.

T009 says 'fetch a public educational dataset ... (e.g., via `ucimlrepo` or a named, reachable OpenML dataset URL)'. 'e.g.' leaves the dataset unspecified — an implementer cannot deterministically execute or verify 'the exact dataset URL' in the source log when no dataset is named. Name the concrete dataset/package in the task (or point to the verified-datasets block in research.md as the authoritative source).

T014 produces results.md but names no verification: unlike T008/T010/T011/T012, there is no check (e.g., every number in results.md traceable to a results.json key per Constitution IV, or a lint that no hand-typed statistics appear). Add an explicit verification clause so done-ness is checkable.

T011 says 'per-concept results (if N_concepts > 1) to data/results/by_concept/' but no task or contract defines the per-concept file schema/filenames. An implementer cannot deterministically produce or verify these files. Specify the filename pattern and that each file validates against the same contract schema.
